name: Special Chow
description: Kan Chow siam zingah chuan a tui ber a ni a, Chow pangngai a kan telh thin zawng zawng chawhpawlh bakah a tih tui nan thil dang chi hrang hrang pawh tel a ni a. Soup pawh a chhawm tel bawk.
description-en: This is the most premium of Chow/Chowmein category. Apart from all the from all other chows this dish comes with other special sesoning. The dish also includes free Soup.

name: Special Rice
description: Kan Fried Rice siam zingah chuan a tui ber a ni a, Fried Rice pangngai a kan telh thin zawng zawng chawhpawlh bakah a tih tui nan thil dang chi hrang hrang pawh tel a ni a. Soup pawh a chhawm tel bawk.
description-en: This is the most premium of Fried Rice category. Apart from all the from all other Fried Rice this dish comes with other special sesoning. The dish also includes free Soup.

name: Vegetable Chow
description: Chow kan tih hi Chowmein a ni a. Chow pangngaiah hian Thlai rah/hnah remchang apiang telh thin a ni a - a remchan dan ang zelin carrot, bean, sweet corn, green peas te hi telh a ni tlangpui. Heng bakah hian a remchan chuan thlai dang tel thin a ni bawk.
description-en: Chowmein locally knows as chow mix with various vegetables based on availability like carrot, bean, sweet corn, green peas with extra vegetable. Free Soup is included in the dish (however the soup is not 100% vegetrian)

name: Chicken Chow
description: Chow kan tih hi Chowmein a ni a. Chow pangngaiah hian Thlai rah/hnah remchang apiang telh thin a ni a - a remchan dan ang zelin carrot, bean, sweet corn, green peas te hi telh a ni tlangpui. Heng bakah hian arsa telh a ni. Soup a chhawm bawk e
description-en: Chowmein locally knows as chow mix with various vegetables based on availability like carrot, bean, sweet corn, green peas with added chicken. Free Soup is included in the dish

name: Chow Var Satui Leih
description: Chow kan tih hi Chowmein a ni a. Chow ah hian Satui a hranpa telh a ni a. Satui leih bakah hian Soup a chhawm tel tho bawk.
description-en: Chowmein locally knows as chow. This is a local dish chowmein watered with Meat Soup (Meat based on availability, mostly chicken). This also includes free soup.

name: Egg-topped Chow
description: Chow kan tih hi Chowmein a ni a. Chow pangngaiah hian Thai rah/hnah remchang apiang telh thin a ni a - a remchan dan ang zelin carrot, bean, sweet corn, green peas te hi telh a ni tlangpui. Hemi chungah hian artui kan dah tel a ni a, artui kan hi a hmin leh hmin lo in a siam theih a, sawi a nih hran loh chuan a hmin lo in siam a ni. Soup a chhawm tel bawk.
description-en: Chowmein locally knows as chow mix with various vegetables based on availability like carrot, bean, sweet corn, green peas with Fried egg toppings. If you have a preference of half fried or fully fried egg, please say so while ordering. Free Soup is included in the dish

description: Chowmein hi Soupy Chowmein kan tih thin kha ni a. Chow(Chowmein) pangngai ang tho a ni a, tuiril zawk a siam a ni thung. Thlai rah leh hnah remchan ang zelin pawlh a ni.
description-en: Chowmein word locally refers to soupy chowmein, mixed with available vegetables

name: Chicken Roll
description: Atta/Maida kan leh Arsa Roll a ni a, a chhungah hian bawlhlo chi hrang hrang telh a ni.

name: Beef Roll
description: Atta/Maida kan leh Bawngsa Roll a ni a, a chhungah hian bawlhlo chi hrang hrang telh a ni.

name: Egg Chicken Roll

name: Lassi
description: Bawnghnute atanga siam khawlum lai a in chi vawt tui tak a ni.
description-en: Regular lassi. Cold Drink made from Dahi

name: Cold Coffee
description: Coffee vawt dai raih mai a siam, vur nen a pawlh, tuihnai tak a ni.
description-en: Regular Cold Coffee

name: Strawberry Milkshake
description: Bawnghnute, Strawberry leh vur khang chawhpawlh.
description-en: Mixture of Diary, Strawberry essence and Ice

name: Chocolate Milkshake
description: Bawnghnute, Chocolate leh vur khang chawhpawlh.
description-en: Mixture of Diary, chocolate and Ice

name: Vanilla Milkshake
description: Bawnghnute, Vanilla leh vur khang chawhpawlh
description-en: Mixture of Diary, Vanilla essence and Ice

name: Alu Bawngsa
description: Alu leh Bawngsa siam pawlh, Mizo duh dan tak a siam a ni.
description-en: Gravy or Soupy mix of Potatoes and Beef

name: Sachek
description: Sachek tuihnai leh thianghlim tak a sawngbawl a ni a. Thianghlim tak a sawngbawl a nih avangin a kha ve fuk lo a, rim dang a nam lo bawk.
description-en: Instestine of Cattle, cleaned thoroughly and prepared with good bitter taste.

name: Bawng Soup
description: Bawngsa ti tha lai leh ruh atanga siam, bawngsa chhum han leh tui hang tui em em mai.
description-en: Specially prepared beef soup made from the meat and bones.

name: Chilli Chicken
description: Arsa kan leh Hmarcha tui tak a bawl a a ni
description-en: Chicken mix with a hot chilli.

name: Chicken Dry Fry
description: Arsa kan ro tui tak a bawl a ni.
description-en: A dry fried chicken. However the product is not generally dry

name: Sawhchiar
description: Mizo arsa sawhchiar dik tak hmui tui em em a siam a ni
description-en: Local porridge

name: Sanpiau
description: Burma sawhchiar a ni a, papawr leh sa leh thil dang dang telh a ni.
description-en: Porridge originated from Myanmar mix differently for local taste

name: Mix
description: Sawhchiar leh Chow mix a ni tlangpui a, palte a suah chi thil dang nen pawh a mix theih tho bawk.
description-en: A mix of either Sanpiau or Sawhchiar with Chow. If you prefer another mix please mention clearly

name: Alu Paratha
description: Alu leh Maida chawhpawlh, tui tak a kan a ni a, bawlhlo dang te pawh telh a ni.
description-en: Regular Aloo Paratha slightly different as a signature

name: Omlette
description: Artui kan a bik tak a siam.
description-en: Regular plain omlette

name: Chana
description: Motor chana hlang hmanga siam a ni.
description-en: Regualr cook motor chana

name: Artui chhum
description: Artui chhum hmin.
description-en: Hard boiled egg

name: Paratha
description: Puri ti a sawi a ni bawk. Maida nuai sa, tel sa a thlak (deep fry) a ni.
description-en: Puri or Paratha deep fried

name: Chhangban
description: Mizo chhang ti a sawi a ni bawk. Buh/buhban atanga siam sa, kan (deep fry) a ni.
description-en: Local taste, sticky bun. Goes really well with paratha

name: Alu chop
description: Alu chhum rawt sawm artui a plaster.

name: Pakora

description-en: Besan Pakora, may be a lot bigger than some local variants

name: Chhangpuar

description-en: Deep Fried plastered bread with its natural sweetness

name: Thingpui

description-en: Regular sweet tea

name: Mineral Water
description: Tui - bur khat (400 - 500 ml).
description-en: A mineral watter bottle (400-500ml) just in case you need it.
